title: Sheep May Safely Graze (Schafe können sicher weiden), from Cantata BWV 208
video_use_ideas: Warm, reassuring bed for a long-term vision or community thank-you.
legal_notes: Composition PD worldwide (J. S. Bach d.1750). Mutopia piece 1794 ('Schafe Können Sicher Weiden (Sheep Will Safely Graze)', for Two flutes, soprano, and basso continuo); licence shown as Public Domain on the piece page, in the Mutopia RDF and in the .ly header (placed in the public domain by typesetter Jeremy Visser). Edition source: Breitkopf & Härtel, 1881. Scored for two flutes, soprano and continuo (the soprano line renders as an instrument in MIDI). Preview is an own FluidSynth (FluidR3_GM) render of the Mutopia MIDI, not a human performance; no recording in this row.
licence_meaning: PD / CC0 / PDM / US-gov recording and score. Commercial use, no credit needed (courtesy credit still listed where the source asks).
